# orchard_vm (Resource)

Manages a virtual machine in Orchard.

## Example Usage

```terraform
provider "orchard" {
  token    = "your-service-account-token"
  base_url = "http://localhost:8080"
}

resource "orchard_vm" "example" {
  name     = "dev-box"
  image    = "ghcr.io/openai/orchard/images/ubuntu-24.04:latest"
  cpu      = 2
  memory   = 4096
  disk_size = 20
  headless = true

  labels = {
    tier = "dev"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `image` (String) VM image reference.
- `name` (String) Unique name of the VM within the cluster.

### Optional

- `arch` (String) Architecture (arm64 or amd64). Cannot be changed after creation.
- `cpu` (Number) Number of CPUs.
- `disk_size` (Number) Disk size in GB.
- `headless` (Bool) Run without graphics.
- `host_dirs` (List of Object) Host directories to mount (see [below](#nestedatt--host_dirs))
- `image_pull_policy` (String) Image pull policy (IfNotPresent or Always).
- `labels` (Map of String) Labels for worker selection.
- `memory` (Number) Amount of RAM in megabytes.
- `net_bridged` (String) Bridged network interface (e.g., en0).
- `net_softnet` (Bool) Use Softnet network isolation.
- `net_softnet_allow` (List of String) CIDRs to allow when using Softnet.
- `net_softnet_block` (List of String) CIDRs to block when using Softnet.
- `nested` (Bool) Enable nested virtualization.
- `os` (String) Operating system (darwin or linux). Cannot be changed after creation.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) SSH password.
- `power_state` (String) Desired power state (running, stopped, suspended).
- `restart_policy` (String) Restart policy (Never or OnFailure).
- `resources` (Map of Number) Resource requirements for the worker.
- `runtime` (String) Runtime (tart or vetu). Cannot be changed after creation.
- `startup_script` (Attributes) (see [below](#nestedatt--startup_script))
- `suspendable` (Bool) Enable suspend/resume support.
- `username` (String) SSH username.

### Read-Only

- `generation` (Number) Incremented by the controller on each spec change.
- `ip` (String) Current IP address of the VM.
- `local_name` (String) Local name of the backing VM (read-only).
- `observed_generation` (Number)
- `status` (String) Current status of the VM.
- `status_message` (String)
- `worker` (String) Worker assigned to this VM.

<a id="nestedatt--host_dirs"></a>
The `host_dirs` block supports:

Required:

- `path` (String)

Optional:

- `name` (String)
- `ro` (Bool)

<a id="nestedatt--startup_script"></a>
The `startup_script` block supports:

Required:

- `script_content` (String)

Optional:

- `env` (Map of String)

## Import

Import is not currently supported.
